images.alt: Retro pop-art three-panel comic featuring a glamorous blonde woman in a cozy sweater and jeans debating beauty with her smug, fluffy tabby cat. Panel 1: She praises elegance and style; the cat prefers sunbeams and relaxation. Central embrace: flowing red backless gown and black tuxedo, surrounded by blended scenes of a masked ballroom, museum jewel heist, private jet arrival, casino, penthouse party, yacht escape, rooftop rendezvous, car chase, helicopters and rooftop pursuit. Merge scenes through translucent profiles, city skylines embedded in hair and clothing, ocean reflections, chandeliers, headlights and architecture.
